goal: Prevent incoming Tor connections from misclassifying as clearnet and gaining IP whitelist permissions
Avoid starting automatic Tor onion services when explicit binds lack a dedicated onion listener
agreement: Strong support with multiple ACKs and no open objections (vasild, winterrdog)
Verified build and tests on FreeBSD (winterrdog)
Open suggestion to replace listenonion with a dedicated bind parameter (vasild)
Open suggestion to fail startup only if listenonion, bind, and whitelist are all set (hodlinator)
Past objections about upgrade startup failures resolved by disabling Tor listening instead (sedited, mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a security bug where incoming Tor peers could inherit localhost whitelist permissions
Prevents misclassification of onion traffic forwarded to standard listeners without dedicated binds
